summary: lithium (liquid) self_diffusion = 0.00022 cm2/s via NVIDIA ALCHEMI Toolkit (nvalchemi 0.2.0) NVTLangevin + NVE velocity Verlet, cuEquivariance/MACE-MP-0 medium (float32) 250-atom cubic cell at fixed experimental density 0.4832 g/cm3 (Ohse 1985 via Yamdb arXiv:2402.10922); melt 3 ps Langevin 1500 K; Langevin NVT 5 ps at 800 K (friction 0.01/fs); NVE velocity Verlet production 20 ps; D from slope of multi-origin COM-corrected MSD (Einstein relation), fit window 2-10 ps lag; uncertainty from 4 x 5 ps blocks
